title: Customer Support Executive
summary: Customer support executives answer customers of banks, online stores and service companies over phone, chat and email, resolving queries and complaints about orders, accounts and bills. They work in a contact centre or support team, often in shifts, and are measured on handle time, customer satisfaction and quality scores.
dailyDuties: Answer inbound calls, chats and emails from customers
Resolve queries on orders, payments, refunds or accounts
Log each interaction with notes and the right disposition in the CRM
Escalate cases that need another team and follow them up
Meet daily targets on handle time, quality and CSAT
Follow process and compliance steps such as identity checks

skills.expectation: Resolve customer queries and complaints about orders, accounts or services
Handle customers over voice, chat and email, often in rotational shifts
Meet targets on AHT, CSAT, first contact resolution, quality and SLA
Calm upset customers and escalate cases correctly when needed
Record clear notes and the right disposition for every interaction
Work in a CRM or ticketing tool to log and track customer cases
Work in a CRM or ticketing tool to log and track customer cases
Speak and write clearly and politely in English and Hindi or a regional language
Offer suitable products or upgrades during service calls
Check KYC documents for banking and fintech requests
Process return, replacement and refund requests for e-commerce orders
Keep simple trackers and daily reports in Excel
Work out what the customer needs and find the fastest fix
